sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Silver-Plated Dainty White Stone Nath – Sparkling CZ Studded with Teardrop Drop
sourceNotes.rawContent: Complete your ethnic look with this stunning silver-toned nath, featuring a delicate circle of shimmering white stones and a dainty teardrop charm. To maintain its radiant luster and high-fashion finish, avoid contact with moisture or perfumes and store it safely in a dry place after use.
